questions.question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution can the President of India be impeached for violation of the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 61 of the Indian Constitution details the specific procedure for the impeachment of the President of India.

questions.question: Who presides over a Joint Sitting of both Houses of Parliament convened under Article 108?
questions.explanation: As per Article 118(4), the Speaker of Lok Sabha presides over a joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament.

questions.question: What is the maximum permissible gap between two sessions of the Indian Parliament?
questions.explanation: Article 85 mandates that Parliament must meet at least twice a year, with no more than 6 months gap between sessions.

questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution empowers the President of India to grant pardons and suspend or commute sentences?
questions.explanation: Article 72 grants executive clemency powers to the President to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment.

questions.question: Which Article confers ordinance-making power on the President when Parliament is not in session?
questions.explanation: Article 123 empowers the President to promulgate ordinances during the recess of Parliament.
